descriptionEn: Doubanjiang, dried chilies, and dark soy. Spicier and more aggressive than Shanghainese.
descriptionZh: 豆瓣酱、干辣椒、老抽。比上海红烧肉更辣、更烈。

stepsEn: Blanch pork belly 5 min. Drain and cut into 4cm cubes.
In a wok, melt rock sugar to amber caramel. Add pork and toss to coat.
Add doubanjiang and stir-fry 1 min. Add dried chilies, ginger, star anise, cinnamon, both soy sauces and Shaoxing wine.
Add boiling water to just cover. Bring to a boil, reduce to low. Braise 1.5–2 hours, checking occasionally.
Uncover and increase heat. Reduce sauce until thick and glossy. The fat should be translucent.
stepsZh: 五花肉焯水5分钟，切成4cm块。
炒锅融化冰糖至琥珀色焦糖，放入猪肉翻拌上色。
加豆瓣酱翻炒1分钟，放入干辣椒、姜片、八角、肉桂、两种酱油和绍兴酒。
加沸水刚好没过，大火烧开转小火，焖煮1.5-2小时，偶尔查看。
开盖大火收汁至浓稠发亮，肥肉应呈半透明状。
details.notesEn: The difference between Hunan and Shanghai versions is doubanjiang and dried chili — the Hunan version has an edge, a heat that cuts through the fat. Chairman Mao allegedly ate this for breakfast. I believe it.
details.notesZh: 湘式与上海版的区别在于豆瓣酱和干辣椒——湘式带着锋芒，一股穿透肥腻的辣。据说毛主席把这道菜当早餐吃，我信。
